about: Why a page's request to the local gateway is refused, and the sentence a person reads. The gateway sends `reason` (a legacy value every SDK since 0.4 knows) and, for the cases a newer SDK can say better, `code` (the specific reason). A client shows the text of `code` when it knows it and of `reason` otherwise. daemon/gateway, sdk/web and sdk/goclient all test against this file; change the words here and in nothing else.

reasons.text: You declined. The app stays disconnected from this computer.
The dialog on this computer was not answered in time. Try again and answer it.
You declined a moment ago. Wait half a minute before asking again.
Several connection requests were declined in a row, so agentd is not asking for a while. Try again in a few minutes.
Another connection request is waiting for an answer on this computer. Answer it first.
This computer cannot show the confirmation dialog (no graphical session), so nothing was connected.
No folder was chosen, so nothing was connected. Choose at least one folder to allow.
The app refused the pairing code. Start the connection again to get a fresh one.
agentd could not save the connection on this computer. Look at its log, then try again.
agentd does not accept requests from this address. Use the address the app is served from, without a path.
agentd did not accept the address used to reach it. Open the page from its usual address.
agentd did not understand the request. Update agentd and try again.
This agentd does not know the request. Update agentd and try again.
agentd could not carry out the request. Look at its log, then try again.
agentd runs as another user than this program, so it refuses the request.

clientReasons.text: agentd on this computer did not answer. Check that it is running.
